search_notes: CAPItello-281. AstraZeneca high-level results release of 25 Nov 2024: statistically significant rPFS improvement, no numbers. The AZ page was not reachable at the URL tried; opened OncLive and Urology Times coverage, both dated 25 Nov 2024 and citing the release. HR 0.81 (0.66-0.98), p=0.034, first seen in the Annals of Oncology paper published online 19 Oct 2025 with the ESMO 2025 presentation. AstraZeneca's Q3 2024 results (12 Nov 2024) were not opened to rule out an earlier line.

Gentuximab (金妥昔单抗, anti-VEGFR2) + paclitaxel, second-line gastric. Changchun High-Tech (SZSE 000661, parent of GeneScience) notice no. 2026-058 dated 22 Jul 2026 (posted on cninfo the evening of 21 Jul): NDA accepted; the pivotal randomised double-blind phase 3 (CTR20220815, 754 subjects, OS primary) 'met the primary endpoint with statistical significance'; no numbers. Matched to this registry number by design and size (registry: 752, OS), not by NCT number. The 2025 annual report (21 Apr 2026) says only 'phase 3 completed'. No PubMed record; an earlier conference abstract (e.g. ASCO 2026) was not ruled out. Web search budget ran out part-way through this tranche, so this row rests on direct lookups (sponsor site, exchange disclosure platform, PubMed, registry) rather than a general web search.

Orelabrutinib vs chlorambucil + rituximab, first-line CLL/SLL. Earliest explicit result I could open is InnoCare's FY2025 annual results announcement (HKEX, 25 Mar 2026): median PFS NR vs 19.4 mo, HR 0.32 (0.18-0.58), p<0.0001 (it mislabels the comparator as bendamustine + rituximab). Full paper in Signal Transduct Target Ther on 6 Jul 2026 (PMID 42402625): met at interim analysis, data cutoff 17 May 2024. THE TRUE FIRST DISCLOSURE IS PROBABLY EARLIER: the NDA was accepted in Aug 2024 and approved on 25 Apr 2025, but the H1 2024, FY2024 and H1 2025 results announcements and the approval notice, all opened, state no result. A conference abstract, the Chinese label or Chinese-language press was not searched. Web search budget ran out part-way through this tranche, so this row rests on direct lookups (sponsor site, exchange disclosure platform, PubMed, registry) rather than a general web search.

QL1203 (Qilu, privately held) + mFOLFOX6 in RAS wild-type mCRC. Nothing found: no PubMed record by NCT number or 'QL1203' (the one hit is unrelated preclinical work), registry status unknown and not updated since May 2023. Qilu files nothing with an exchange. Conference abstracts and Chinese-language sources were not searched. ARTISTRY-7. Mural Oncology release of 25 Mar 2025 (GlobeNewswire, read in a StockTitan copy): at the pre-specified interim analysis nemvaleukin + pembrolizumab did not achieve a significant OS improvement (median 10.1 vs 9.8 mo, HR 0.98, no CI); 'highly unlikely to achieve success at the final analysis', trial will not continue to final analysis. Coded stopped_futility although the release does not use the word and the registry says 'business and strategic decision'; could be argued as not_met.

which_endpoint: PFS (dual primary with ORR; both met)
search_notes: SUNMO. Roche release of 20 Jun 2025 with the ICML late-breaking presentation: PFS HR 0.41 (0.28-0.61), ORR 70.3% vs 40.0%. Roche's Q1 2025 sales release (24 Apr 2025) was opened and does not mention SUNMO, but the Q1 slide deck and pipeline appendix were not opened; with a 123-day lag an earlier one-line pipeline entry cannot be excluded. JCO paper 2 Oct 2025 (PMID 41037766).

which_endpoint: ORR and PFS (dual primary; ORR disclosed first)
search_notes: BREAKWATER. Dual primary endpoints disclosed 6 weeks apart. ORR (61% vs 40%) first appeared in the FDA accelerated-approval notice of 20 Dec 2024, which is the first disclosure recorded here; Pfizer's Q2 and Q3 2024 results releases (30 Jul, 29 Oct 2024) were opened and say nothing on BREAKWATER. PFS was reported as met in a Pfizer release of 3 Feb 2025 (read in CancerNetwork coverage of that date; 45 days after the ORR, 26 days before the registry date). HR cells are for PFS, not ORR: 0.53 (0.41-0.68), NEJM / ASCO 30 May 2025. If the row should be anchored on PFS, first disclosure is 2025-02-03 and the lag is -26 days.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR (dual primary with OS; either suffices)
search_notes: ROSELLA. Corcept release of 31 Mar 2025 (the registry date itself): PFS met, median 6.5 vs 5.5 mo; interim OS 16.0 vs 11.5 mo. The copy opened (TipRanks) gives '30 percent reduction in risk' without the HR; HR 0.70, p=0.008 is in an HMP article of 4 Apr 2025 citing the release, so hr_in_first_disclosure is yes but hr_first_public_date is the dated page I opened and is probably 4 days late. No CI until the Lancet paper of 2 Jun 2025: 0.70 (0.54-0.91) (PMID 40473448). Corcept's own release was not reachable. OS final analysis reported as met in Jan 2026 (search summary only).

LEAP-014. No stand-alone release. First disclosure is one sentence in Merck's Q2 2025 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1, 29 Jul 2025): a pre-specified interim analysis did not show a significant OS improvement. Merck's Q1 2025 release (24 Apr 2025) was opened and has no mention. HR 0.92 (0.77-1.10), p=0.1852, first shown at ESMO 2025 (OncLive 17 Oct 2025; data cutoff 8 May 2025 = registry date). The trial was then closed (registry: terminated, an uninformative 'why stopped'); coded not_met rather than stopped_futility because no source says futility.

IOB-013 / KEYNOTE-D18. IO Biotech release and 8-K of 11 Aug 2025 (read in a StockTitan rendering of the filing): PFS by BICR HR 0.77 (0.58-1.00), p=0.056 against a threshold of p<=0.045; median 19.4 vs 11.0 mo. Narrow miss. Presented at ESMO 2025.

KEYNOTE-905 / EV-303. Merck, Pfizer and Astellas releases of 12 Aug 2025 (read in Targeted Oncology coverage of that date): EFS, OS and pCR all significantly improved at the first interim analysis, no numbers. HR 0.40 (0.28-0.57) at ESMO 2025 LBA2 (Urology Times, 18 Oct 2025); NEJM 18 Feb 2026 (PMID 41707170). Merck's Q2 2025 release of 29 Jul 2025 was opened for another trial but not searched for this one.

SERENA-6. AstraZeneca release of 26 Feb 2025: highly statistically significant PFS improvement at a planned interim analysis, no numbers; four months before the registry primary completion date. HR 0.44 (0.31-0.60) in NEJM / ASCO, 1 Jun 2025. AstraZeneca's FY2024 results (6 Feb 2025) were not opened.

BRUIN CLL-313. Lilly topline release of 8 Sep 2025, no numbers. Lilly's Q2 2025 results release (7 Aug 2025) was opened and mentions only the sibling CLL-314. HR 0.20 (0.11-0.37) in Lilly's release of 9 Dec 2025 with the ASH late-breaking presentation and JCO paper (PMID 41363773: 0.199, 0.107-0.367); the ASH late-breaking abstract may have gone online a few days earlier.

Benmelstobart (TQB2450) + AL2846 vs docetaxel, NSCLC after immunotherapy. No Sino Biopharm HKEX announcement since June 2024 names this trial (title list read), and AL2846 does not appear in the FY2025 annual results (26 Mar 2026) or the H1 2026 results (19 Aug 2026). PubMed: only phase 1/2 AL2846 papers. Registry status unknown since Dec 2024. Web search budget ran out part-way through this tranche, so this row rests on direct lookups (sponsor site, exchange disclosure platform, PubMed, registry) rather than a general web search.

SACHI. First stated inside HUTCHMED's NDA-acceptance release of 2 Jan 2025: the IDMC considered the pre-defined PFS endpoint met at a planned interim analysis and enrolment was closed; no stand-alone topline. The breakthrough-designation release of 12 Dec 2024 was opened and has no result. HR 0.34 (0.23-0.49) investigator-assessed, ITT, in HUTCHMED's release of 2 Jun 2025 (ASCO late-breaking session on 1 Jun); Lancet 13 Jan 2026 (PMID 41544643). Registry primary completion date is 7.5 months after the disclosure.

AK104-308, cadonilimab + lenvatinib + TACE in HCC. Akeso's H1 2026 results announcement (HKEX, 27 Aug 2026) says enrolment is ongoing in the phase 2/3 study COMPASSION-29 of this regimen; matched by design, not by protocol number. No Akeso voluntary announcement on it since Jan 2025 (title list read); no PubMed record.

Paclitaxel polymeric micelles in metastatic breast cancer. Shanghai Yizhong (SSE 688091) H1 2026 report (25 Aug 2026) says the phase 3 trials in breast and pancreatic cancer 'continue to progress steadily'; no result announcement in its 2025-2026 notices (title list read); no PubMed record.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR (dual primary with OS; OS met later)
search_notes: AK104-303 / COMPASSION-16. Akeso HKEX voluntary announcement of 23 Nov 2023: PFS met at an interim analysis by the IDMC, OS not yet formally tested; no numbers. This is 25 months before the registry's estimated primary completion date. PFS HR 0.62 (0.49-0.80) and OS HR 0.64 (0.48-0.86) in the Lancet paper of 16 Oct 2024 with the IGCS presentation. Approved by the NMPA in June 2025.

DB-1303 / BNT323 (trastuzumab pamirtecan) vs T-DM1, China. Joint BioNTech and DualityBio release of 5 Sep 2025 (BioNTech 6-K exhibit) naming NCT06265428: PFS met at a pre-specified interim analysis, no numbers; five months before the registry's estimated date. A China BLA was reported accepted in Apr 2026 (search summary). No hazard ratio found: no PubMed record, and conference programmes were not searched. Sibling: the global DYNASTY-Breast02 trial in HER2-low disease is a different study.

SHR-1210-III-316, camrelizumab + apatinib vs chemotherapy, second-line gastric. Registry updated 20 Jan 2026: still recruiting, primary completion estimated 1 Apr 2026. None of Hengrui's 40 application-acceptance notices since June 2024 (all downloaded and searched) concerns it, and the H1 2026 report (19 Aug 2026) has no such trial result. PubMed: only an unrelated phase 2. Web search budget ran out part-way through this tranche, so this row rests on direct lookups (sponsor site, exchange disclosure platform, PubMed, registry) rather than a general web search.

SHR-A1921-303, TROP2 ADC vs chemotherapy in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer. No result found. SHR-A1921 is listed for this indication in Hengrui's 2024 annual report and H1 2025 report, but is absent from the pipeline tables of the 2025 annual report (25 Mar 2026) and is not mentioned at all in the H1 2026 report (19 Aug 2026): possibly a quiet discontinuation, which no source states. Registry not updated since Aug 2024 (recruiting). None of Hengrui's acceptance notices since June 2024 concerns it. PubMed: phase 1 and other tumour types only. SI-B001 (izalontamab) + docetaxel in NSCLC. Sichuan Biokin's H1 2026 report (26 Aug 2026) counts one SI-B001 registrational study as ongoing and reports no result; no SI-B001 result notice among Biokin's SSE announcements (only a 2023 FDA IND notice). PubMed: phase 1 only.

SYS6010-011 / SYNSTAR-01. CSPC HKEX voluntary announcement of 26 Aug 2026: PFS met at the pre-specified interim analysis as assessed by the IDMC, OS trend; no numbers. CSPC's interim results announcement of 20 Aug 2026 was opened and does not carry the result. No hazard ratio public yet (PubMed has the phase 1 only).

BL-B01D1-301 (iza-bren vs platinum chemotherapy, EGFR-mutant NSCLC after EGFR-TKI). Sichuan Biokin (SSE 688506) notice no. 2026-060 dated 18 Aug 2026 (posted on cninfo the evening of 17 Aug), Chinese only, names protocol BL-B01D1-301: PFS met at the pre-specified interim analysis per the iDMC, OS trend; no numbers. Siblings: Biokin has some 20 iza-bren phase 3 trials, several in NSCLC; this notice is matched by protocol number. No hazard ratio public yet.

SUCCESSOR-2. The date is taken from BMS's Q1 2026 results release (8-K exhibit, 30 Apr 2026), whose pipeline table lists '9 March: positive interim results from the Phase 3 SUCCESSOR-2 trial' (significant PFS improvement); the 9 March release itself was not opened because the BMS news site blocks scripts. BMS's Q4 2025 release (5 Feb 2026) was opened and has no mention (the page was truncated near its end). HR 0.48 (0.36-0.63) in the Lancet paper published online 14 Jun 2026. Interim-analysis win, trial continuing; six months before the registry's estimated date.

Garsorasib (D-1553) vs docetaxel, KRAS G12C NSCLC. Registry: recruiting, not updated since Apr 2024, primary completion estimated Oct 2026. No PubMed record.
